profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Azure | Ex-AWS
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft specializing in backend APIs, cloud infrastructure, and mobile test development across AWS and Azure platforms. Expert in distributed systems and scalable architecture with a unique foundation in electrical engineering (EIT, California).

positions.locationName: Seattle metropolitan area, Washington, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, L64
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft Azure Core, Cloud + AI, specializing in backend serverless APIs, distributed systems, and cloud native infrastructure. Expert in C#/.NET cross-platform development for large-scale cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
AWS EC2 Mac - Software Development Engineer leveraging iOS/macOS expertise for EC2 Mac instance lifecycle management, resilient boot systems, and automated AMI generation.

AWS Device Farm - Technical Lead for iOS testing infrastructure serving thousands of devices. Achieved >96% device availability, 3x backend capacity improvement, and reduced release deployment from 1 month to 1 week. Expert in SwiftUI, UIKit, and testing frameworks (XCUI, XCTest, Appium, Calabash).

positions.title: Transportation - ITS/Electrical Systems (EIT)
positions.description: Engineer-in-training (EIT) in intelligent transportation and electrical systems for the Port of Oakland.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer (EIT)
positions.description: Engineer-in-training (EIT) on electrical rail systems for New York Railroad.
